faces.transcription: Take 1 Action token and give it to one player. Remove all Checkpoint tokens from the board.
faces.flavor: The Soviets have grafted the final, deadly strain of the MEDUSA plague onto ragweed pollen, inspired by the Japanese Fu-Go balloon bombs from World War II. Next month, they intend to launch Operation LION'S TOOTH, a series of weather balloons loaded with millions of grains of contaminated pollen. Once the balloons reach their targets, they will release the pollen, and there will be nowhere to hide.
